summary: Administrator user, password and deletion mutations now write redacted audit records containing actor, action, target, request id, request origin, timestamp and previous/next summaries in the same atomic commit, with regression coverage; no defects found.

evidence: src/auth_store.ts adds AdminUserAuditRecord, key helper and listAdminUserAudit, and writes the audit record inside the same atomic commit for saveUser, savePasswordCredential, clearPasswordCredential and deleteUser.
src/passport.ts supplies audit context with actor id and handle, action, generated request id and request origin for the PATCH user, POST/DELETE password and DELETE user routes.

src/handler_test.ts asserts seven owner audits covering handle/email rename, password set/clear, role demotion and promotion, and deletion, including actor, origin, request id and no password hash leakage.

tests/bun_test.ts verifies audit writes are atomic with password mutations, that a rejected audit commit leaves the credential and sessions untouched, and that clearing an absent password writes no record.
